subject.title: fix(ollama): resolve web search secret refs

question: Should provider-specific normalization and unavailable-configured-ref callbacks become permanent API in the plugin SDK web-search credential resolver?
rationale: Repairing credential precedence is mechanical, but the generality and permanence of these externally consumable callbacks requires API-owner intent.

options.title: Approve narrow optional hooks
options.body: Keep the backward-compatible hooks after restoring and testing the independent hosted credential path.

options.title: Use a constrained helper
options.body: Replace the generic callbacks with a named shared helper exposing only the established SecretRef policy needed by Ollama.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow optional hooks
recommendation.body: Keep the backward-compatible hooks after restoring and testing the independent hosted credential path.

likelyOwner.reason: Git history shows sustained ownership of the shared resolver and its credential precedence contract.
